title: Product expectation over ranking profiles
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and for each voter $i<n$ let $q_i$ assign a real number to each strict ranking of three candidates. Choose a ranking profile uniformly from all profiles of length $n$. The expected value of the product over voters of $q_i$ evaluated at voter $i$'s ranking equals the product over voters of the uniform expectations of their respective functions $q_i$.
hypotheses_covered: a function $q_i$ from rankings of three candidates to real numbers for each $i<n$
